interpretation_limits: Each of the two source filenames supplies a video-level label only; there is no manual per-frame error, phase, or event ground truth.
Geometry buckets are not pose recognition or verified hold segments. Even the arms-down bucket includes low elbow angles and possible transition or projection effects.
Frames within each video are highly correlated; no independent subject split is available, and these videos must not be reused to claim generalization.
The full-body fixed ROI, front-view claim, image bounds, and actual pose correctness were not manually verified in this audit.
All features pass the configured score gate of 0.5, but this does not guarantee landmark accuracy or adequate camera view. Scores can exceed one and are not calibrated probabilities.
All thresholds discussed are opt-in experimental hypotheses, not professionally validated yoga teaching standards.

recommendations.most_supported_demo_candidate: In an explicitly selected and manually verified overhead-hold variant, examine per-side elbow angle < 160 deg, recovery >= 165 deg, persistence 1500 ms. These are conservative round-number engineering candidates; not selected by held-out validation.
recommendations.elbow_evidence: In the geometry-only both-arms>150deg bucket, correct P05 L/R=169.32/167.24deg versus incorrect=153.51/148.66deg. The incorrect source has min-elbow<155deg from 53.720s to 58.852s. The correct source has no min-elbow<165deg run lasting >=1000ms in that bucket. Manual video review is still required.
recommendations.shoulder_and_torso: Keep descriptive or opt-in demo only. Distributions overlap strongly and incorrect does not consistently have larger tilt. They cannot establish discrimination on these two videos.
recommendations.ankle_spacing: Keep monitoring until variant and hold phase are confirmed. Correct starts with >0.4 lasting 5.699s, so a blanket >0.4 rule would flag a source-labeled correct video. Overhead buckets median 0.280 vs 0.350 have substantial overlap and do not justify a universal stance rule.
recommendations.arm_alignment: Overhead arm-angle lower threshold can be a disabled candidate after explicit target-variant confirmation. Do not derive a valid alert merely from a self-selected >150deg bucket; doing so is circular.
recommendations.duration: 1500ms is an engineering starting value only. Use timestamp gaps and invalid frames to interrupt continuity; do not count missing periods as valid hold.
recommendations.default_policy: Keep real corrective feedback disabled until camera view, target stage/variant, rule source, and sample review are confirmed; expose experimental deviations as comparison evidence instead of validated diagnosis.
